authority_order: approved EventPoster inventory and exact pixel identity
conflicts: hero/gallery fill-first exception versus open exact-geometry incident contract
mutable listing manual overrides versus immutable pixel identity
exhibitions protected-natural metadata versus unconditional CSS cover
core_invariants: No global ratio, fit, crop, object-position or upscale default exists.
A crop window never changes media identity and is computed per asset plus consumer target.
Protected or unknown semantics cannot be upgraded to cover by orientation or OCR absence.
Stale or missing geometry cannot authorize protected-region crop.
A solver contain result cannot be silently rewritten to cover.
Missing media cannot carry crop or focal decisions.
Static resolved Astro HTML cannot be replaced by an artificial skeleton.
Broken and missing are distinct causes even when a profile selects one fallback family.
Consumer exceptions remain explicit profile rules and never become core defaults.
Every decision exposes a stable reason code and pinned provenance.

pipeline.decision: Use only approved canonical EventPoster media and immutable pixel identity.
Classified event_photo may be crop-eligible; OCR, document, poster and unknown remain protected.
Geometry may authorize crop only when its pixel SHA equals the current pixel SHA.
Resolve geometry, fit exception and ratio only from one explicit consumer profile.
Union face and valuable regions with margin and solve an exact target-aspect window.
pipeline.fail_closed_result: contain when the protected union cannot fit

pipeline.decision: Apply profile-specific selection and explicit upscale action.
Keep loading, loaded, missing, broken and tiny distinct and preserve profile geometry.
